# Featured Papers

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### [Archaeal histone-based chromatin forms extended polymeric structures in vivo](<https://doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.rs-10925841/v1>)
*Thomas Santangelo, Geraldy Liman, Marina Black, Andrea Engel, Alexandra Harte, xiaowei Zhao, Momoko Shiozaki, Christopher Bleck, Zhiheng Yu, Jennifer Lippincott-Schwartz* <br>
The chromatin architecture of *Thermococcus kodakarensis* dynamically transitions from a uniform nucleoid during exponential growth to tightly packed helical filaments and globular condensates in stationary phase, demonstrating that organized genomic packaging can occur without eukaryotic-style remodeling complexes or extensive histone modifications.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### [Evolution of new cerebellar nuclei by excitatory progenitor diversification in the early rhombic lip](<https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.17.751883>)
*Manjari M-G Anant, Eli Clemens Zuercher, Maggie Lowman, Caleb Shi, Dylan Z. Faltine-Gonzalez, Michael L. Piacentino, Jean Fan, Justus M. Kebschull* <br>
Developmental diversification and spatial segregation of excitatory progenitors establish distinct nuclear territories and circuits in the evolving cerebellum, paving the way for generic inhibitory neurons to subsequently integrate into these regions.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### [Flow, dynamics and active fracture in hydraulic multicellular systems](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2609.21021v1>)
*John D. Treado, Arthur Boutillon, Frank Jülicher, Otger Campàs* <br>
A theoretical model integrating cellular mechanics and fluid transport reveals that tissue hydraulics regulate cell responses to osmotic stress, direct inter- and intracellular fluid movement, and suppress cell mobility to drive lumen-generating fractures.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### [Dynamic fracture and catastrophic crack branching in highly entangled hydrogels](<https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.2603322123>)
*Hang Yang, Shuming Kang, Yujing Du, David A. Weitz, Joost J. Vlassak* <br>
Localized viscous dissipation at the crack tip significantly reduces dynamic fracture toughness below quasi-static levels, with a shear-lag model predicting that fracture energy scales inversely with a Weissenberg-like number incorporating strain rate, chain length, mesh size, and solvent viscosity.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### [Posture selection in active elastic filaments](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17924v1>)
*Adam Pearl, Ludwig A. Hoffmann, L. Mahadevan* <br>
A theoretical framework combining mechanical equilibrium and optimal control theory demonstrates that slender active bodies regulate their geometry under fluid and gravitational loads through trade-offs between control cost, dynamical stability, and functional demands.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### [PTPN1/2 Inhibition Remodels the Pulmonary Myeloid Landscape to Induce Alveolar Macrophage-Mediated Control of Lung Metastasis](<https://doi.org/10.1158/0008-5472.can-26-0770>)
*Yue Liu, Im-Meng Sun, Marc Creixell, Jordan Brown, Samir Kharbanda, James J. Lee, Varahram Shahryari, Kayley Hake, Jacqueline O'Hara, Kenneth J. Finn, Nianxin Yang, Lolita Penland, Jiaxi Wang, Ka Man Li, John Balibalos, Aaron W. Stebbins, Patrick M. Godfrey, Po-Han Tai, Evangelia Malahias, Wenjun Kong, Nicole Fong, David Hendrickson, Shagun Gupta, Leanne JG. Chan, Fiona E. McAllister, Chirag H. Patel, Marcia N. Paddock, Tuan Andrew. Nguyen, Fiona A. Harding, Jonathan D. Powell* <br>
Amplification of IFNγ-STAT1 signaling using the clinical-stage drug AC484 removes a molecular constraint on tissue-resident alveolar macrophages, enhancing their accumulation and tumoricidal activity to combat metastatic progression in lung microenvironments where adaptive immunity is limited.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### [Comparative anatomy of chicken and human forelimb muscles: Implications for human congenital conditions through developmental models](<https://doi.org/10.1111/joa.70228>)
*Julia Dong Hwa Oh, Megan G. Davey, Melina Eleni Bell, Meera Arun Singhal, Wee Leon Lam* <br>
Stylopod and zeugopod muscles exhibit high structural conservation between species, enabling chicken embryonic models to directly inform soft-tissue surgical management for human congenital limb conditions such as radial dysplasia.
:::

## More Papers

#### [Transport of Deformable Vesicles Driven by Chiral Active Brownian Particles](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18743v1>)
*Dipak Patra, Anil Kumar Dasanna* <br>
